## House Rulings

- Mention the 1 Silver fog toll and the 4-crate swap errata while handing out Sloops so nobody hits a surprise on Turn 2.
- Treat only the single printed dashed channel from the 5P Auxiliary Pier to East Quay as legal until Tideglass issues an FAQ update.

## BGG Notes

* Remember that another captain's Sloop never waives the 1 Silver fog toll; only a lit Brass Lantern adjacent to the channel makes it free.
